item.title: Up to $20,000 available to support inclusive environments in NSW community preschools
item.description: Eligible NSW community and mobile preschools can access up to $20,000 to make environmental modifications that support children with disability and additional needs, with the final child-based application round for 2026 closing in October.

item.title: Let’s Stop Bullying campaign launches: what can ECEC learn about prevention before school?
item.description: A new Australian Government campaign is tackling bullying and harmful behaviours among school-aged children, but its focus on prevention and early intervention also raises an important question for early childhood education and care: what foundations can be laid before children reach school?

item.title: Two new public preschools open in Queanbeyan, creating places for up to 160 children each week
item.description: Two new fee-free public preschools have opened in Queanbeyan, creating capacity for up to 160 children each week as the NSW Government continues the rollout of its $769 million public preschool expansion program.

item.title: Arena REIT posts strong FY26 growth but flags uncertainty following Edge Early Learning default
item.description: Arena REIT has reported a 62 per cent increase in statutory profit for FY26, supported by rental growth, new early learning centre developments and property revaluations, while flagging uncertainty for the year ahead following the issuing of default notices to Edge Early Learning across 31 leases.

item.title: Ignite Minds Family Day Care suspension puts child safety in focus, while committed providers and educators continue to uphold quality
item.description: The Victorian Early Childhood Regulatory Authority (VECRA) has suspended the service approval of Ignite Minds Pty Ltd and four of its family day care educators following the identification of serious breaches of the National Law and National Regulations that created risks to children’s safety.
